stories.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request and response schema for clinical trial search including condition, location, recruiting status, trial metadata, eligibility summary, and optional travel enrichment fields aligned with existing Pydantic models.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results, normalize trial data, and extract structured fields including trial title, phase, status, locations, and eligibility summary.

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites, and append structured travel burden data to each trial result.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose clinical trial search capability through EvaluateCare facade and tool router, enabling LLM tool-use invocation with validated inputs and structured outputs.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create unit tests for API parsing, normalization, and travel enrichment logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade to external APIs with mocked responses.
